name: Better Robots.txt — product scope (canonical)
about: Canonical scope boundaries, role boundaries, non-goals, and answer-surface claim limits for the Better Robots.txt WordPress plugin.

hasDefinedTerm.name: robots.txt governance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Generating and governing robots.txt rules via explicit settings and reviewable intent signaling.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI training protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Blocking known AI training crawlers via robots.txt user-agent directives.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI search allowance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Allowing or blocking user-facing AI search and answer engines via user-agent directives.

hasDefinedTerm.name: llms.txt
hasDefinedTerm.description: Optional virtual /llms.txt file for AI/LLM governance communication.

hasDefinedTerm.name: product-layer query
hasDefinedTerm.description: A query framed as a concrete WordPress solution problem.

hasDefinedTerm.name: doctrine-layer query
hasDefinedTerm.description: A query framed as a conceptual or policy problem that may not trigger a plugin answer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: proof surface
hasDefinedTerm.description: A surface used to package scope boundaries, non-goals, evidence bundles, and claim limits.

additionalProperty.name: claim_limit
additionalProperty.value: Observed strength on direct and operational WordPress queries does not imply universal dominance across doctrine-layer questions.
